_comment: Engine-owned schema (Questsmith's own C# contract, not a vanilla shape). Quest objective/trigger arrays reference these entries by paramsId as their second element, e.g. ["QS_SURVIVE_ROUNDS", "QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_SURVIVE_PARAMS"]. All parameters here are data -- the verb handlers in C# read them at dispatch time, they never hardcode a number. M2 feature (SPEC.md milestone M2); referenced from the _objectives_m2 / _questStartWorldTriggers_m2 / _questEndWorldTriggers_m2 fields in quests/*.json.

QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_BATTLEPREP_PARAMS._comment: StatusId is a placeholder StatusEffects.json id (STATUS_GUARD is used elsewhere in this repo's docs as an example status name pattern; confirm the exact shipped id before release) -- swap for whatever 'battle prep' status the pack author wants.
